# RouterIPHub - Complete Programmatic Technical Knowledgebase
Date: 2026-11-03
Website: https://routeriphub.com

## 1. Gateway IP Directory
- IP: 192.168.1.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Netgear, ASUS, Linksys, Cisco, Verizon Fios, Ubiquiti
  Default Credentials: admin / admin or admin / password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-1/

- IP: 192.168.0.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: TP-Link, D-Link, Arris, Sky Broadband, Virgin Media
  Default Credentials: admin / admin (or created on first boot)
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-0-1/

- IP: 10.0.0.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24 standard local allocation)
  Brands: Xfinity (Comcast), Apple AirPort, Cisco, Spectrum
  Default Credentials: admin / password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-0-1/

- IP: 192.168.1.254
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: AT&T Fiber (BGW320), BT Smart Hub (UK), Plusnet, 2Wire
  Default Credentials: admin / Printed Access Code
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-254/

- IP: 192.168.2.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Belkin, SMC, Bell Home Hub (Canada), Philips Hue Bridge
  Default Credentials: admin / [empty] or admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-2-1/

- IP: 192.168.8.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Huawei, GL.iNet Travel Routers, 4G/5G Mobile Hotspots
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-8-1/

- IP: 192.168.10.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Trendnet, ZyXEL, Motorola Gateway combos
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-10-1/

- IP: 192.168.11.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Buffalo AirStation, DD-WRT Japanese releases
  Default Credentials: root / [empty] or admin / password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-11-1/

- IP: 192.168.12.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet (KVD21, Arcadyan, Sagemcom)
  Default Credentials: admin / sticker password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-12-1/

- IP: 192.168.31.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Xiaomi Mi WiFi, Redmi Routers
  Default Credentials: admin / set on first boot via miwifi.com
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-31-1/

- IP: 192.168.68.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: TP-Link Deco Whole Home Mesh Series (X55, XE75, BE85)
  Default Credentials: Managed via TP-Link Deco App
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-68-1/

- IP: 192.168.88.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: MikroTik RouterBOARD & RouterOS (hAP, RB series)
  Default Credentials: admin / [empty]
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-88-1/

- IP: 192.168.100.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Huawei ONT, Motorola & Arris Cable Modems, Virgin Media Modem Mode
  Default Credentials: admin / admin (or TelecomAdmin)
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-100-1/

- IP: 192.168.178.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: AVM FRITZ!Box (7590 AX, 6660 Cable, 5590 Fiber)
  Default Credentials: admin / sticker password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-178-1/

- IP: 10.0.1.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Apple AirPort Extreme, AirPort Time Capsule, Cisco
  Default Credentials: admin / admin (or configured via AirPort Utility)
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-1-1/

- IP: 10.0.0.138
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Telstra (Australia), Thomson / SpeedTouch, Technicolor
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-0-138/

- IP: 192.168.1.2
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Wi-Fi Range Extenders, Secondary Access Points, Repeater Hubs
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-2/

## 2. Hardware Models Database
- Model: Netgear Nighthawk AX6 (RAX50)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://routerlogin.net
  Credentials: admin / password
  Reset: With the router powered ON, press and hold the recessed Reset button on the rear panel with a paperclip for 10 seconds until the Power LED starts blinking amber. Release the button and wait 2 minutes for full reboot.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/netgear-nighthawk-rax50/

- Model: Netgear Nighthawk AX12 (RAX120)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://routerlogin.net
  Credentials: admin / password
  Reset: Hold the rear pinhole Reset button for 10 seconds using an unfolded paperclip while powered on. The power LED will flash amber, signaling the factory wipe.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/netgear-nighthawk-rax120/

- Model: Netgear Nighthawk Pro Gaming XR1000
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://routerlogin.net
  Credentials: admin / password
  Reset: Press and hold the Reset button on the back panel for 10 seconds. DumaOS 3.0 will reset to factory defaults and initiate the setup wizard on next login.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/netgear-nighthawk-xr1000/

- Model: Netgear Orbi Tri-Band Mesh AX4200 (RBK752)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://orbilogin.com
  Credentials: admin / password
  Reset: Press the pinhole Reset button on both the router (RBR750) and satellite (RBS750) for 10 seconds until the ring LED pulses amber.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/netgear-orbi-rbk752/

- Model: Netgear Orbi Tri-Band Mesh AX6000 (RBK852)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://orbilogin.com
  Credentials: admin / password
  Reset: Hold the reset button on the bottom-rear panel for 10 seconds. The front light ring will flash amber during factory restore.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/netgear-orbi-rbk852/

- Model: TP-Link Archer AX55 (AX3000)
  IP: 192.168.0.1
  Domain: http://tplinkwifi.net
  Credentials: admin / Created on first setup (or admin on legacy v1)
  Reset: While powered on, press and hold the physical Reset button on the back panel for at least 6 seconds until all front panel LEDs turn off and on.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/tp-link-archer-ax55/

- Model: TP-Link Archer AX21 (AX1800)
  IP: 192.168.0.1
  Domain: http://tplinkwifi.net
  Credentials: admin / Created on first boot
  Reset: Hold the WPS/Reset button on the rear panel for 5 seconds until the status LEDs blink. The device reboots with factory settings.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/tp-link-archer-ax21/

- Model: TP-Link Archer BE800 (BE19000)
  IP: 192.168.0.1
  Domain: http://tplinkwifi.net
  Credentials: admin / Set during setup wizard
  Reset: Press the pinhole Reset button for 5 seconds. The front LED matrix screen will display a reset animation.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/tp-link-archer-be800/

- Model: TP-Link Deco X55 AX3000 Mesh
  IP: 192.168.68.1
  Domain: http://tplinkdeco.net
  Credentials: Deco App Account (TP-Link ID) / Set in Deco Mobile App
  Reset: Press the pinhole Reset button on the bottom of the Deco unit for 1 second. The single LED indicator will change to pulsing yellow.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/tp-link-deco-x55/

- Model: TP-Link Deco BE85 (BE22000)
  IP: 192.168.68.1
  Domain: http://tplinkdeco.net
  Credentials: TP-Link Cloud ID / Set in Deco App
  Reset: Press the Reset button on the base of the unit for 1 second until the LED pulses yellow.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/tp-link-deco-be85/

- Model: ASUS RT-AX88U (AX6000)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://router.asus.com
  Credentials: admin / admin (prompts to change immediately)
  Reset: Power ON the router. Press and hold the Reset button on the rear panel for 5-10 seconds until the Power LED starts flashing slowly. Release and wait 3 minutes for AsusWRT to reboot.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/asus-rt-ax88u/

- Model: ASUS RT-AX86U / RT-AX86U Pro (AX5700)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://router.asus.com
  Credentials: admin / admin
  Reset: Hold the Reset button for 5 seconds until the power light flashes. Alternatively, hold the WPS button while powering on for a Hard Factory 30-30-30 NVRAM wipe.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/asus-rt-ax86u/

- Model: ASUS ROG Rapture GT-AX11000
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://router.asus.com
  Credentials: admin / admin
  Reset: Press and hold the recessed Reset button for 5 seconds until the Aura RGB ROG eye logo flashes red and power LED blinks.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/asus-rog-rapture-gt-ax11000/

- Model: ASUS ZenWiFi AX (XT8)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://router.asus.com
  Credentials: admin / admin
  Reset: Press the pinhole Reset button on the bottom of the unit for 5 seconds until the front LED glows yellow.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/asus-zenwifi-xt8/

- Model: ASUS RT-BE96U (BE19000)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://router.asus.com
  Credentials: admin / Set during setup
  Reset: Hold the Reset button for 5 seconds until power LED flashes. Wait 3 minutes for the quad-core 2.6 GHz CPU to initialize.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/asus-rt-be96u/

- Model: Linksys Max-Stream AC1900 (EA7500)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://myrouter.local
  Credentials: admin / admin
  Reset: Press and hold the red Reset button on the back panel for about 10 seconds until the illuminated Linksys logo starts flashing.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/linksys-ea7500/

- Model: Linksys Velop Tri-Band Mesh (WHW0303)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://myrouter.local
  Credentials: admin / admin
  Reset: Press and hold the red Reset button on the bottom of the node. The top LED will turn red, fade, and then flash bright red. Release immediately.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/linksys-velop-whw0303/

- Model: Linksys Max-Stream Mesh Wi-Fi 6 (MR9600)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://myrouter.local
  Credentials: admin / admin
  Reset: Hold the red Reset button on the back for 10 seconds until the top light flashes red.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/linksys-mr9600/

- Model: Ubiquiti UniFi Dream Machine Pro (UDM-Pro)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: https://unifi.ui.com
  Credentials: UI Cloud Account / root (SSH) / Set during UniFi OS setup wizard
  Reset: Locate the recessed Reset button on the front panel. Press and hold for 10 seconds until the front LCM touchscreen displays 'Restoring to Factory Defaults'.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/ubiquiti-unifi-dream-machine-pro/

- Model: Ubiquiti AmpliFi HD Home Mesh
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://amplifi.lan
  Credentials: admin / Set in AmpliFi App
  Reset: Press the pinhole Reset button on the bottom of the cube router for 10 seconds until the circular touchscreen shows the reset icon.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/ubiquiti-amplifi-hd/

- Model: MikroTik hAP ax³ (C53UiG+5HPaxD2HPaxD)
  IP: 192.168.88.1
  Domain: http://router.lan
  Credentials: admin / Empty (No password) on first boot
  Reset: Unplug power. Hold the front Reset button. Plug in power. Keep holding until the USR LED starts flashing (5 seconds) for RouterOS default reset, or hold 10 seconds for CAPsMAN mode, or 15 seconds for Netinstall.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/mikrotik-hap-ax3/

- Model: MikroTik RB4011iGS+5HacQ2HnD-IN
  IP: 192.168.88.1
  Domain: http://router.lan
  Credentials: admin / Empty (No password)
  Reset: Hold the reset button while powering on for 5 seconds until the LED starts flashing to clear configuration.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/mikrotik-rb4011/

- Model: Arris SURFboard SB8200 DOCSIS 3.1
  IP: 192.168.100.1
  Domain: http://192.168.100.1
  Credentials: admin / password (or last 8 digits of serial number)
  Reset: Insert the end of a paperclip into the Reset button on the rear panel. Hold for 10-15 seconds until all front panel LEDs turn off and then flash.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/arris-surfboard-sb8200/

- Model: Arris SURFboard G36 DOCSIS 3.1 & AX3000
  IP: 192.168.0.1
  Domain: http://192.168.0.1
  Credentials: admin / password (or Wi-Fi preshared key on sticker)
  Reset: Press and hold the Reset button on the rear panel for 15 seconds until all LEDs flash simultaneously.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/arris-surfboard-g36/

- Model: Amazon Eero Eero Pro 6E (Tri-Band AXE5400)
  IP: 192.168.4.1
  Domain: N/A (Managed exclusively via Eero Mobile App)
  Credentials: Amazon / Eero App Account / App managed (No browser HTTP GUI)
  Reset: To Soft Reset (clears network config without deleting settings): Hold the Reset button for 7 seconds until the LED flashes yellow. To Hard Factory Reset: Hold the Reset button for 15 seconds until the LED flashes red.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/amazon-eero-pro-6e/

- Model: Amazon Eero Eero Max 7 (Tri-Band BE20800)
  IP: 192.168.4.1
  Domain: N/A (Eero App)
  Credentials: Amazon / Eero Account / App managed
  Reset: Hold the reset button on the back for 15 seconds until the LED turns solid red to trigger a complete factory wipe.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/amazon-eero-max-7/

- Model: Google Nest Nest Wifi Pro (Wi-Fi 6E AXE5400)
  IP: 192.168.86.1
  Domain: http://192.168.86.1 (Shows Google Home App prompt)
  Credentials: Google Account / Managed via Google Home App
  Reset: To factory reset using the hardware button: Unplug the power cord. Press and hold the reset button on the bottom of the device. While holding the button, plug the power cord back in. Continue holding for about 10 seconds until the light pulses solid white, then release.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/google-nest-wifi-pro/

- Model: GL.iNet Beryl AX (GL-MT3000)
  IP: 192.168.8.1
  Domain: http://192.168.8.1
  Credentials: root / admin / Set on first browser visit
  Reset: Power on the router. Press and hold the Reset button on the side panel for 10 seconds until the blue LED flashes rapidly. Release the button.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/gl-inet-beryllium-gl-mt3000/

- Model: D-Link EXO AX5400 (DIR-X5460)
  IP: 192.168.0.1
  Domain: http://dlinkrouter.local
  Credentials: Admin / password (or printed on configuration card)
  Reset: With the unit powered on, insert a paperclip into the Reset hole on the rear panel. Hold for 10 seconds until the power LED flashes orange.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/d-link-exo-ax5400/

- Model: Synology RT6600ax Tri-Band Router
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://router.synology.com
  Credentials: admin / Set during SRM quick start wizard
  Reset: Regular Reset (admin password & network settings reset): Hold the RESET button for 4 seconds until the router beeps once. Hard Reset (restore factory defaults & wipe SRM): Hold the RESET button for 10 seconds until the router beeps twice.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/synology-rt6600ax/

- Model: AVM FRITZ!Box FRITZ!Box 7590 AX (VDSL/Fiber)
  IP: 192.168.178.1
  Domain: http://fritz.box
  Credentials: admin / Printed on the underside base sticker
  Reset: AVM routers do not have a physical pinhole button. Reset by navigating to System > Backup > Factory Settings in the web GUI (http://fritz.box). If locked out, connect an analog phone and dial #991*15901590* to trigger factory restore.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/avm-fritzbox-7590-ax/

- Model: Cisco Catalyst 1000 Series (C1000-8T-2G-L)
  IP: 192.168.1.254
  Domain: http://192.168.1.254
  Credentials: cisco / cisco
  Reset: Press and hold the front Mode button for 10 seconds. Release when all LED lights illuminate solid amber.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/cisco-catalyst-1000/
